description: Before writing a function, ask "does something already do this?": ranks existing bodies by similarity to a candidate `signature` or `body` snippet. structural:true matches identifier-renamed (Type-2) clones. Call to AVOID re-implementing existing logic.

body.description: A candidate code snippet (function body) to check for existing implementations

graph.description: Path to graph.json. OPTIONAL — defaults to CODEWEB_WS or the nearest .codeweb/graph.json above cwd

signature.description: A candidate function signature to check for existing implementations

name: codeweb_find_similar
